title: KnxMappingConfig
description: Configuration schema for the KNX adapter mapping. Describes how KNX group value read, group value write, group value response, and observe/monitor intents are normalized into BASIS authorization requests. Routes match on (operation, group_address); '*' is a wildcard sentinel and group addresses are matched verbatim with no topology expansion. Values, payloads, payload types, priority, and datapoint types are never template fields — they remain protocol evidence.

routes.description: Ordered list of route mappings. Routes are evaluated in order; the first match wins.

KnxRouteMapping.description: Maps a KNX operation and group address to normalized authorization semantics.

name.description: Optional human-readable route name. Must be unique across all routes in the config if non-empty.

operation.description: KNX operation to match (protocol-intent name). Use '*' to match any operation.

group_address.description: Group address to match verbatim (e.g. '1/2/3'), or '*' to match any. Exact string comparison only — no topology expansion, no range matching, no semantic inference.

action.description: Normalized action verb. If empty, the default operation→action map is used (GROUP_VALUE_READ→read, GROUP_VALUE_WRITE→write, GROUP_VALUE_RESPONSE→read, OBSERVE→subscribe).

resource_id_template.description: Template for the resource ID. May reference {operation}, {group_address}, {individual_address}, {device_address}, {communication_object}, {area}, {line}, {device} using {param} syntax. Values, payloads, payload types, priority, and datapoint types are not available as template fields.
